## ITVenueBlock type

Represents a venue block configuration for Telegram venues.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITVenueBlock = {
    title: string;
    address: string;
    latitude: string;
    longitude: string;
};
```

## Remarks

This type defines the structure for template-driven venues declared with `<g-venue>` blocks. All four fields support the same `{{var|filter}}` interpolation pipeline as poll questions; the compiled strings are validated at runtime before any API call (non-empty title/address plus `Ctx.assertLocation` range checks on the coordinates).

## Example


```typescript
const venue: ITVenueBlock = {
  title: `Cafe {{name}}`,
  address: `Jl. Merdeka 1`,
  latitude: `-6.2`,
  longitude: `106.8`
};
```
